description: Headers v1-v4 compare as lists, framed by the reply another way: Vary on one line with no space after its comma, and Cache-Control as two field lines. Today's verifier passes them, ignoring whitespace around commas and splitting the headers it knows are lists; janus verify passes the pact, and the contract it upgrades into compares each as http:list (ADR 0082)
source: staged plan S3.3; pact_models::headers::parse_header and pact_matching's header comparison
